core_obligations: Pass to an etale chart and apply the schemes-side criterion to the chart morphism.
Descend the conclusion using etale locality of formal unramifiedness, and show one surjective chart suffices.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose an etale chart of the morphism.
Apply the schemes-side formal unramifiedness criterion.

difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises formal unramifiedness of a morphism of algebraic spaces through etale charts: the morphism is formally unramified exactly when every chart morphism between schemes is, and it suffices to test one chart with surjective vertical arrows. The proof passes to a chart, applies the schemes-side criterion for the chart morphism, and then descends using that formal unramifiedness is etale local on the source and target. The descent through the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2745-2780.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair. The A side characterises formal unramifiedness of a morphism of schemes through affine-local conditions; this side characterises it for algebraic spaces through etale charts. The statements differ in category and in the test data, so both are counted; this card records the algebraic-spaces side. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the A side is stated for morphisms of schemes and tests on affine opens; this side for algebraic spaces and tests on etale charts with surjective vertical arrows. Conclusion difference: the test data and the ambient category both differ, so the statements are distinct and both count.
